name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haaaaaaaah...」
I let out a huge sigh, practically blowing out every last bit of air in my lungs.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I really did it now... Aaaah, I'm an idiot, I'm the biggest idiot ever」
Back in my dorm room, I was holding a solo self-reflection session.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I mean, come on, doing that in the school building is totally out of bounds, I got way too carried away」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why do I have zero self-control like this」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sure, it felt amazing, I'll admit... Yeah, can't deny that」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Still, I can't just give in to pleasure！ I'm a swordswoman, after all！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, maybe that doesn't really have anything to do with it right now？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No, no, whatever it takes, you need to discipline yourself, Setsugekka！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It's banned, masturbating is banned！ I'm going to become a pure, chaste maiden！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「All riiight, let's do this」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whaaa！？」
The intercom suddenly rings, startling me.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Setsugekka, you're in there, aren't you. Do you have a moment」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, yeah, coming, I'll open it right now」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Excuse me for coming in. Were you in the middle of something？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ack... J-Just reflecting on my behavior today, maybe？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hmm, well, I suppose it doesn't matter」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「S-So, Kei-chan, did you need something from me？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That teacher came by for introductions today, right？ I wanted to hear your thoughts on what kind of impression you got」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「M-M-M-Muragaki-sensei！？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes. Why are you so flustered？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I-I'm not flustered！ I'm just trembling with fighting spirit！」
Aaaah, her stare is seriously stinging...

name: Keisetsu
message: 「So, what kind of person did you think Muragaki Iori was, Setsugekka？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-What kind...? Well, normal, I guess?」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, that does not constitute a statement of your impressions.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I need to know whether Muragaki Iori is worthy of instructing you. Therefore, I wish to consult your opinion.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Tell me, how did you feel when interacting with him？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I mean, even if you ask me that, we only talked a little after I went berserk, so I still don't really know what kind of guy he is.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Though, it seems like he stopped me while I was rampaging, so I think he's more skilled than my previous teachers.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setting aside the matter of your rampage, which I will have you explain at a later date—」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Flinch, flinch!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Then there is no obstacle to you receiving instruction from him, correct？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Th-There's a massive obstacle！！！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Such as？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh？ Ah, uuuuh... It's fine, there's no obstacle after all.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, if something is bothering you, speak up properly.」

name: Setsugekka
message: （L-Like I could ever tell you~！）
Even if she is my twin sister, there's no way in hell I'm telling her I don't want him teaching me because I'm too embarrassed that he caught me masturbating.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-Well, he's a lot younger than I expected, so I was just thinking it'd be bad if we ended up in, like, some kind of lewd relationship~」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Indeed, the possibility of him lusting after a student cannot be denied. Understood, I shall remain vigilant.」
Aaah, now he's under false suspicion... I'm sorry, I'm so sorry, Muragaki-sensei...

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Anything else？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Let's see... maybe that he's pretty handsome~, or something？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「So from your perspective, he could be a romantic prospect. I will pay particular attention to that point.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa？！ How did you interpret it like that？！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You find him handsome because you are interested in him as a member of the opposite sex, do you not？ Rather, I wonder if any other interpretation even exists.」
Aaaaah, now I've really dug my own grave~！

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Anything else？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I don’t！ There’s nothing left to hide！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, what are you trying to brush off？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-well, even I have one or two things I can’t tell you, Big Sis.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hmmmmm, I see. Got it.」
Ah, that’s scary. Big Sis’s ‘hmm’ is terrifying！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, that’s right. Nakamura Sakura’s match broadcast is coming up. So, if you could just end the conversation here...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You really like her, don’t you? What do you even see in Nakamura Sakura?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh~? Why！ She’s cool, isn’t she！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I’m not trying to criticize your tastes.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I just want you to remember this, Setsugekka.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You and I are two sides of the same coin. We are going to become the heads of the Kazamine family.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「To that end, we infiltrated this academy, into the very belly of the lion. To devour and tear down the Suzakuin from within.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I know. My role is to defeat Suzakuin Momiji.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, exactly. And to do that, you need to master your power.」
Kei-chan taps my shoulder gently.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, you must draw out Muragaki Iori’s guidance and build up enough strength to strike down Suzakuin Momiji.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Use him. Use Muragaki Iori.」
Leaving those words behind, Kei-chan left the room.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Whew.」
I throw my body onto the bed and roll around.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「‘Use him,’ she says so easily...」
Using a teacher is something Kei-chan could probably pull off, but I’m not capable of anything that difficult.
―Kei―chan and I were born as identical twins.
Kei-chan was born first, and I was born after. That’s why Kei-chan is the big sister and I am the little sister.
Kei-chan has been extremely smart since she was little. She was hailed as a prodigy and called the shining hope of the Kazamine.
Conversely, I don’t have much confidence in what’s inside my head.
I suspect Kei-chan probably took about half of the brain matter for herself.
But I don’t resent her for it. Because in return, Kei-chan was always kind to me.
Whenever I was in trouble, Kei-chan always helped me, and whenever I was worried, she always comforted me.
Kei-chan is my big sister whom I'm so proud of. I feel so lucky to have been born as Kei-chan's little sister.
Even getting into Murakumo Academy here was only possible because I begged Kei-chan and she somehow made it happen for me.
I never could have managed it on my own.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I was really surprised when Kei-chan suddenly said she'd come to the academy with me too, though.」
Kei-chan is super busy with work, and she's smart enough that she doesn't even need to attend an academy.
And yet, she came along with me, saying, 'I'd be worried letting Setsugekka go all by herself.'

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...I really want to do something about me going berserk.」
Kei-chan probably feels responsible for me ending up with a constitution like this.
That's why she indulged my selfish request and arranged for my enrollment at the academy. And now, she's worried about my training.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even though going berserk is all my fault...」
...I think it was around two years ago.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, Kei-chan... what should I do?」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「What's wrong, Setsugekka? You look so serious.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...I might not be able to get any stronger than this.」
After returning from the Jindou training grounds, I told Kei-chan.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Oh my, why do you say that？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Master told me so today.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「He said my psychic resonance level is way lower than the average for professional Jindou fighters...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I see...」
You can develop your skills through training. However, the psychic resonance level used to manifest Tenju is something you're born with.
Having a low number means I can't enhance my physical abilities as much as others, my speed is inferior, and my Barrier Jacket is weak.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What should I do, hey, what should I do, Kei-chan...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I can't be of any use to you, Kei-chan... I'm just an unwanted child!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Calm down, Setsugekka.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You're my precious little sister. How skilled you are with a sword doesn't matter at all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sniff... But Kei-chan, you're always saying it, aren't you？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「'We're going to become the head of the Kazamine family.'」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「'And to do that, we have to prove that we're useful to the Kazamines,' you said.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But I can't do any of the amazing things you can do, Kei-chan.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If I can’t be strong in Jindou, then I’m nothing at all...！」
Kei-chan has a brilliant mind, better than anyone’s, and a charm that draws people in. But I have nothing that makes me superior to anyone else, other than my Jindou skill.
Keisetsu-onee-chan and I—we were born as twins, so why are we so different?

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, Kei-chan, I want to be stronger.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I want to be able to be of use to you, Kei-chan...！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka...」
After that, Kei-chan researched all sorts of things for my sake.
My innate ability, the <d0056>Mental Resonance Coefficient</d>. She did everything in her power to see if there was some way to raise it.
And then... Kei-chan found a way.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Setsugekka, I cannot recommend this method.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why not？」
The method Kei-chan found carried significant risk. She explained this to me over and over again.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「There have been many reported cases of failure. In the worst-case scenario, it could even cost you your life.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s fine by me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If I can’t get any stronger, I’m just an unwanted child anyway.」
That wasn't just me acting tough; that was my true heart’s feeling.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Why would you say such a thing？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You’re just being self-destructive. I cannot cooperate with someone like that any further！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Hey, Kei-chan, you know？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「When someone’s looking for you and they find me instead, you know what kind of face they make when they realize I’m not you?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I can hear it in their voices... ‘Oh, it’s just the wrong one,’ they say.」
The look of disappointment on their faces when they realized I wasn’t Kei-chan.
It was written all over them: 『You’re useless to me.’

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kei-chan is the one who will be the head of the Kazamine family, not me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You’re the only one they need, and I’m not needed at all！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m not the one saying that—everyone is saying it！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, that’s just your persecution complex...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You wouldn’t understand, Kei-chan！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Because everyone needs you, and everyone acknowledges that they need you！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I want to be acknowledged too… I want to be needed, too…！」
And so, I felt no hesitation.
What of the danger to my life? That sort of thing is of no importance whatsoever.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Please, Onee-chan… make me strong…！！」
Kei-chan listened to that cry of my soul and accepted it.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「…Understood.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If that is what you wish for so deeply, I will exhaust every means necessary to ensure it succeeds.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Thank you, Kei-chan…！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「But there is one thing I want you to understand.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You and I are two halves of one whole, clones split from the same cell.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「To me, you are special. No one can ever take your place.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「So, Setsugekka… no matter what anyone in the world says,」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「you are not an unwanted child.」
And so, I applied to my own body the method to raise the Mental Resonance Coefficient that Kei-chan had discovered.
The results were good.
There were others besides me who underwent the same procedure, but it seems there was variation, with some succeeding and others not.
Kei-chan said that some people didn't manifest any abilities at all, while others had inconsistent results that made them useless.
Amidst all that, I, whose Mental Resonance Coefficient rose significantly, was one of the rare success stories.
However, naturally, there were side effects.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, there’s no such thing as a free lunch—you can't just draw out immense power without paying some kind of price, right?」
Changes in personality, fevers, and increased libido.
The last one basically means getting horny and not being able to help yourself, but I haven't even told Kei-chan about that one.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「There’s no way I could say something that embarrassing out loud!」
But, if you look at it the other way, that’s all it is.
If all it takes is side effects this minor to gain the power to reach Suzakuin Momiji, it’s a bargain of a deal.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s right, so now all that’s left is to master this power！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If I can master it, I can become someone useful just like Kei-chan！」
Motivation bubbled up within me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s right, what’s a little thing like being seen masturbating? That’s really not a big deal at all, is it！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Just like Kei-chan said, I should just toy with Muragaki-sensei in the palm of my hand！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Alright! Now that it's come to this, I'll become a femme fatale and use Muragaki-sensei for all he's worth!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Setsugekkaaa, fight, ohhh！！！」
Alone in my dorm room, I thrust my fist into the air.
